name: APEX Signature
description:
APEX Signature allows you to capture signatures and initials with customizable tools, timestamps, save templates, verification, and sign documents. Features include drawing with color/thickness controls, image upload, webcam capture, undo/redo, eraser mode, date/time overlay, initials mode, saved signature templates, document signing with PDF overlay, and signature verification with SHA-256 hash and audit trail.

Version 3.6.0 New Features:

  • Signature Verification: SHA-256 hash for integrity checking
  • Audit Metadata: Timestamp, IP, user agent, geolocation
  • Tamper Detection: Verify signature has not been modified
  • Audit Log: Complete signing history with localStorage persistence
  • Verification Badge: Visual status indicator (valid/invalid/tampered)
  • Signature Comparison: Compare two signatures for similarity

Version 3.5.0 Features:

  • Initials Mode: Compact component for capturing initials/rubrics

Version 3.4.0 Features:

  • Timestamp Overlay: Date/time with audit info

Version 3.3.0 Features:

  • Customization Toolbar: Color, thickness, eraser, undo/redo

Version 3.2.0 Features:

  • Signature Templates: Save and reuse signatures

Version 3.1.0 Features:

  • Document Signing: PDF/image with signature overlay

Version 3.0.0 Features:

  • Multi-Input Capture: Draw, Upload, Webcam
